recommendation.candidate: Cross-project pending review inbox (bounded extension of GOV-021)
recommendation.why: Existing UI shows and filters plans only for the currently selected project. An approver with multiple explicitly granted projects must switch projects to find pending reviews. T21 supplies explicit membership; existing decision endpoint retains role, self-approval, status, immutable-plan, and integrity checks. A scoped inbox is a coherent reviewer workflow and can reuse those controls.
recommendation.preserve_original: Keep GOV-021 original delegation acceptance/dependencies unchanged; this increment covers the inbox read/review path only and does not implement delegation or claim full GOV-021 acceptance.
development_dependencies: existing project and decision API contracts
bounded_acceptance: Authenticated approver sees pending plans only from projects currently explicitly granted to them; project names, authors, release commit identity, creation time, and status are scoped fields.
Filter by project and status (at minimum pending); selecting a row opens the existing immutable plan review path and submits through the existing decision endpoint.

Non-approver, requester/self, revoked membership, foreign project, archived project, already decided, and malformed/stale rows disclose no foreign records and cannot create a decision; current role/membership is checked at read and decision time.
Cross-project/project-switch/session/credential delayed responses are discarded; membership revocation clears inaccessible rows; failures preserve current scoped state and permit retry.

Isolated PostgreSQL/API/Chromium tests cover multiple projects, role and membership changes, requester exclusion, stale decisions, archive, result ordering/pagination bounds, response invalidation, and no writes from inbox reads. No execution or Oracle assertions.
recommendation.infrastructure: No external provider, credentials, target connection, deployment, or Oracle runtime needed. Query existing PostgreSQL plan/project/grant tables; retain fail-closed behavior during membership bootstrap mode. Product metadata read only; decisions remain explicit and use existing governance controls.
recommendation.limitations: Current plan-detail API loads per-project data and membership grants are enforced in project lookup/listing; an inbox needs a dedicated bounded aggregate query with current grant joins and should not fan out unrestricted project-detail requests. No assignments or delegation exist, so label it pending review inbox for fixed approvers rather than claiming assigned workflow.
